Hi all — quick technical summary based on the call notes and Maya's traffic workbook. Short answer: yes, we can meet Finova's targets with the right configuration and a short PoC. Details below.

1) Latency targets / regional routing
- Architecture: we recommend regional model replicas (US, EU, APAC) with our smart-router in front. Smart-router routes by policy (latency-first with affinity) and supports active health checks + controlled failover to nearest compatible model variant.
- p95 guidance (with dedicated pools + optimizations): US ~200-240ms, EU ~250-300ms, APAC ~300-360ms depending on region egress and peering. Achieving upper-range p95s for APAC will benefit from APAC-local capacity (we can provision a small APAC replica for pilot).

2) Throughput & concurrency (streaming)
- Based on your numbers (peak ~1k reqs/s burst, sustained 400-600 reqs/s, ~800 concurrent streams): we estimate a pilot config of 6-8 GPU replicas per region (A100-class equivalent or q8 quantized V100 equivalents) with continuous batching and per-session KV cache. Exact GPU counts depend on model size - we'll baseline with the model you plan to serve.
- Streaming behavior: our runtime supports chunked/HTTP2-style streaming; we maintain ordering per session. In failover scenarios we enforce session affinity and will deliver a clear failover marker to avoid silent reordering.

3) Data residency & audit evidence
- Options: (A) Dedicated EU cluster (recommended for strict residency) - full data-at-rest in EU, access control enforced via customer-managed IAM; (B) Private VPC with egress controls and regional disk pinning.
- Evidence: we can provide architecture diagrams, a sample redacted audit log extract showing access events and geolocation tags, and our SOC2 report. For procurement we can also provide an agreement clause describing physical location and retention.

4) PoC provisioning and costs
- We can provision a 2-region PoC (US + EU) for 10 business days. Suggested pilot config: 3-4 replicas US, 3 replicas EU (can scale up during test windows).
- Rough cost estimate for pilot (compute + networking + monitoring): ~$6k-$12k depending on chosen instance family and test intensity. We can refine after you confirm model and exact concurrency targets.

Attachments: redwood-slo-matrix.pdf (SRE SLOs & recommended config).

- Finova to send final traffic schedule for the PoC windows.
